summary: Phase 149O.19.3 -- HATP Mandatory Independent-Verification Certification Contract Independent Verification: verification-only phase (no src/pcae/** file, and no contract file, was created or modified). Confirmed baseline via direct inspection: repo clean at entry, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.19.2 completed/complete at 679f9ba6, HMIC-001 v1.0 FROZEN, no certification state, hardcoded False ceiling unchanged, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the full 1,557-line HMIC-001 contract and the full 925-line 149O.19.1 architecture document directly. Independently, mechanically re-extracted (regex/AST, not transcription) HMIC-001's requirement inventory (144, sequential 001-144, gap-free, unique), 12 security invariants (CIVC-1-12), and 32-scenario attack matrix -- all confirmed to match the contract's own declared counts. Independently reimplemented the canonical implementation_scope_digest algorithm (null-byte-delimited, newline-terminated per-file records, lexicographic order, two-level SHA-256) and confirmed by direct test it resists the classic sort-and-concatenate collision ambiguity and correctly distinguishes six adversarial path-canonicalization variants. Confirmed by direct interpreter inspection that the current editable-install topology (PEP 660, Homebrew CPython 3.14.5 global install as well as the repo's pinned .venv CPython 3.9.6) correctly resolves every frozen module to this exact checkout's on-disk files. Confirmed by repository-wide search that no certification writer, API, or state file exists anywhere in src/pcae/** today, consistent with the contract's not-yet-implemented status. Independently computed the one-hop pcae.* import closure of the frozen file set's HATP/HMRC/PB-core subset and found HMIC-REQ-052's transitive-dependency-completeness claim FALSE for one security-relevant dependency: hatp_ag_authority.py, hatp_rollback_consumption.py, and human_approval_trusted_provenance.py (all three in the frozen 18-file set) directly import pcae.core.hatp_providers, which dynamically imports pcae.core.hatp_fido2_provider.Fido2HardwareProvider (or hatp_piv_provider.PivHardwareProvider) -- the modules that perform the actual hardware/cryptographic FIDO2/PIV signature and human-presence verification producing the raw evidence verify_hatp_proof (frozen) consumes to reach a HATP verification status. None of hatp_providers.py, hatp_fido2_provider.py, or hatp_piv_provider.py is named in HMIC-REQ-050's eighteen-file enumeration. An edit to Fido2HardwareProvider.verify() that unconditionally returns signature_valid=True changes zero bytes of any frozen-named file and is completely invisible to implementation_scope_digest -- a certification computed before such an edit would continue validating VALID after it. This is Blocking under this verification's own governing criterion (18-file set under-binds an authority-sensitive production dependency) and is distinct from HMIC-REQ-063's separate, honestly-disclosed import-shadowing/executed-code-binding limitation, which this verification independently confirmed is real but is a disclosed limitation, not a silent gap, and is therefore non-Blocking. Reviewed every other section of the contract (semantic walls, threat model, authority/write/read boundaries, storage topology, schemas, active-pointer/no-implicit-latest, revocation/supersession, concurrency/locking, contract binding and drift detection, self-certification impossibility, bootstrap circularity, cross-contract independence, and the full 32-row attack matrix against its own cited normative anchors) and found no further ambiguity or gap. Wrote a dedicated 34-test independent verification module (tests/test_phase_149o_19_3_hmic_contract_independent_verification.py) deriving expectations from the contract text and independent reimplementation, not from 149O.19.2's own test fixtures; all 34 pass. Ran 149O.19.2's own freeze suite as regression only (35/35 passed, not treated as this phase's own verdict). Ran full Fast Green under the repository's own pinned interpreter (.venv/bin/python3, CPython 3.9.6): raw 5529 passed/28 failed/1 skipped (the 28 identical to the same pre-existing git-diff-baseline-anchored failure class 149O.19.2 already documented, unconditionally pre-existing here since this phase made zero src/pcae/** changes); a second run deselecting those 28 surfaced 4 additional order-dependent failures confined to tests/test_backend_cli.py, confirmed flaky (all 4 pass in isolation and the full 307-test module passes standalone, unrelated to HATP/HMIC/PB entirely); final deselected clean run (32 total deselected): 5525 passed/0 failed/1 skipped -- the value recorded in this phase's structured fast_green metadata field. Ran a broad -k "149o or hmic or hatp or rae or permission_broker" sweep: 4,186 passed/154 failed/4 skipped, all 154 failures in the same pre-existing git-diff-baseline/timestamp-fixture class from unrelated historical phases, none referencing HMIC-001 or any file this phase touched. pcae phase-report trust: Report is COMPLETE. pcae phase-report consistency: Result: consistent. Verdict: NOT VERIFIED -- BLOCKING HMIC-001 CONTRACT FINDING. Implementation-identity verdict: C (under-binds authority-relevant executable state). File-set verdict: INSUFFICIENT (omits hatp_providers.py/hatp_fido2_provider.py/hatp_piv_provider.py). Editable-source verdict: B (safe, non-blocking named deployment limitation). Contract-binding verdict: CLOSED. Self-certification verdict: CLOSED. Concurrency verdict: deterministic/fail-safe at the contract-text level. Recommended next phase: 149O.19.3R (narrow HMIC-001 contract-repair phase) before any 149O.19.4-class implementation phase begins. No certification artifact, active-certification pointer, or revocation record created anywhere in the repository. No Cutover Record or activation marker created or modified. No real Class-B provisioning. No real HATP_MANDATORY activation occurred anywhere. B-149O-1..4 verdict unchanged, carried forward: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED AT SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION/ENFORCEMENT BOUNDARY -- DEPLOYMENT/OPERATIONAL ACTIVATION DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable.
